comment: AWESOME PROF C. Teaches @ J Sarge.  This guy made the class so exciting and fun and I did not even care for eng before. Funny when he is teaching and then pops a joke about something completely random. His assignments are no more than the school is required. He make the assignments easy to understand and teaches techniques to make it fun and easy.

This has to be the best professor I have ever had. He was understanding, professional, and wise yet patient to those who were slower to understand. He was also humble never one to pretend he was more intelligent, or parade around his intellect.

My roommate just rated Prof C, so I don't know if this will show. I had him last year, my roommate has him now (my suggestion). His class was not easy (one person got an A I think), but I thought a lot about things I never think about. It's what I hoped for at UR, to be challenged to think on my own. I wasn't the best student, but I worked hard.

LOL at some of these comments! He's the only prof that uses the text, so of course he makes his own assignments! Most discussions start in small groups, then go to big group (he only talks in big group). I have him now, so IDK about grades. Our book is v interesting but it seems like a lot of students in my class are too dumb to understand it.

I don't think any of the comments here are really accurate at all. I had him last semester, and his assignments are kind of long and detailed, but totally clear. Some discussions were slow, but he listens more than he talks. He isn't an easy grader, but he warned us about this.  He helps a lot outside of class, and my writing improved a ton.

He is not clear on his assignments and you know exactly what he wants. He claims to be a hard grader, but he's really not. And he likes to dominate discussions so just say one thing in class and your participation grade will be fine.
This was the best English class I've ever taken, easily.  Very interesting, very insightful, very helpful, and my writing improved a ton for all of my classes.  Great course!

Let's just say he wears hawaiian shirts and sneakers to class with a bushy beard. He's a little awkward but his class is so easy, eventhough no one knows what the point of it is. Just do the work and you'll be fine. It can be a lot at times but it's not brain bending and he usually gives good grades. Sometimes the assignments are confusing though.

Coudriet's class is good.  I really don't think it is fair to question the point of a Gen Ed course...a course in which the Prof has to meet requirements set by somebody else.  Prof C has always been really helpful to me, and he's really smart and interested in students learning.

This class has had a clear point all along...to read essays related to the course's general theme, and to learn to think independently about ANY issue related to that theme. We have complete independence to pursue our thoughts, something I've never had in ANY English class. I think some of these other reviewers might not be ready for college work.

I have Coudriet, and I don't think the reviews on this site are accurate at all.  He makes up his own assignments.  Other reviewers seem to be confused about the freewriting the course uses to help students respond to readings and develop topics.  He gives us freedom to think, not confusion...he challeges us, and helps to support us along the way.
He's very chill and fun but quite confusing , I feel like his class is a waste of time.
Best class this semester...one of the best teachers I've had.

Sometimes I wonder what the point of his class is! Discussions can be interesting but the assignments and a waste of time and so are the freewrites and responses. The responses are supposed to help with the papers that you have to write but they dont. If you have AP english in high school, this will seem like a waste of time.

Coudriet can be chill, he loves to hear himself talk though. He cracks unamusing jokes constantly. He changes his mind a lot and assignments are unclear. It's a lot of writing but not hard writing. He's not great but he's not horrible, the class is just mad boring.

Weird. Surprisingly insightful. Most of his assignments dont come from him (thanks Joe Essid!) But overall, its just a chill class with a lot of reading. Freewriting gets annoying cause you have to do it every week. Pretty good.

Funny professor who loves what he does. Sometimes directions and assignments can be a little vague and confusing, but overall I learned a lot in this class! You really cant pick a professor for ENG 101 but if you get him, DONT WORRY you will do fine.
